presentation.summary: Sync Silo watch activity, lists, ratings, and dropped shows with Trakt.
presentation.description_markdown: Imports watched movies and episodes, resume progress, favorites, the watchlist, movie and show ratings, and dropped shows from Trakt. Exports completed plays, unwatched titles, favorites, watchlist changes, ratings, and dropped shows, and forwards live playback start, pause, and stop events.
presentation.setup_markdown: Create an API app at [trakt.tv/oauth/applications](https://trakt.tv/oauth/applications) with the redirect URI `urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob`, then enter its client ID and client secret below. Each Silo profile then connects its own Trakt account from its watch-provider settings by entering a code at trakt.tv/activate.

presentation.summary: Recognize western comics by their embedded ComicInfo.xml and enrich series and issues with metadata, creators, and publication details.
presentation.description_markdown: Reads the ComicInfo.xml file embedded in CBZ/CBR archives (as defined by the Anansi Project) and maps its fields onto Silo metadata: title, series, number, count, volume, summary, creators, publisher, genres, tags, characters, teams, locations, age rating, and page info.
presentation.setup_markdown:
Install the plugin, then add ComicInfo Metadata to a comic library's provider chain. Embedded ComicInfo.xml is read with no extra setup. Two optional online sources can be enabled:

**ComicVine** — set `comicvine_api_key` to a free API key from https://comicvine.gamespot.com/api/.

**Grand Comics Database (GCD)** — the plugin reads the official SQLite dump:
1. Create a free account at https://www.comics.org and sign in.
2. Open https://www.comics.org/download/, choose **Private Use**, and copy the SQLite dump link.
3. Paste that link into `gcd_dump_url`.
4. Open the browser DevTools, go to **Network**, reload any comics.org page, open the request headers, and copy the value of the **`sessionid`** cookie. Paste it into `gcd_dump_cookie` as `sessionid=<value>`. If the download returns 403 (Cloudflare), paste the whole Cookie header instead, including `cf_clearance` and `csrftoken`.
5. Set `gcd_dump_path` to where the dump should be saved (for example `/config/gcd.db`) and `gcd_refresh_hours` to how often to refresh it.

The dump is about 6 GB. The cookie is stored encrypted by Silo.

capabilities.description: Reads embedded ComicInfo.xml from western comic archives to populate metadata, creators, and publication details.

global_config_schema.title: Grand Comics Database
global_config_schema.description: Use a local GCD SQLite dump for offline matching. Default on when a path is set.

global_config_schema.title: GCD database path
global_config_schema.description: Full path to the extracted GCD SQLite .db file (e.g. /config/gcd.db). Required to use GCD.

global_config_schema.title: GCD dump download URL
global_config_schema.description: Direct download link for the GCD SQLite dump. Sign in at comics.org, open the Download page, choose Private Use, and copy the SQLite link.

global_config_schema.title: GCD download cookie
global_config_schema.description: Cookie header for the authenticated dump download. Log in at comics.org, then in DevTools → Network → any comics.org request → Request Headers, copy the value of the **sessionid** cookie and paste it as sessionid=<value>. If the download returns 403 (Cloudflare), paste the full Cookie header instead, including cf_clearance and csrftoken. Stored encrypted by Silo.

global_config_schema.title: GCD dump refresh (hours)
global_config_schema.description: How often to re-download the GCD dump when a URL is set. Default 168 (weekly).

global_config_schema.title: ComicVine
global_config_schema.description: Query the ComicVine API for issue metadata. Requires a free API key.

global_config_schema.title: ComicVine API key
global_config_schema.description: Free key from https://comicvine.gamespot.com/api/. Stored encrypted by Silo.

global_config_schema.title: Metron (last resort)
global_config_schema.description: Query Metron only after GCD and ComicVine fail. Off by default.

global_config_schema.title: Metron API token
global_config_schema.description: Token from your metron.cloud account page. Stored encrypted by Silo.

global_config_schema.title: Filename fallback
global_config_schema.description: Infer series, issue number, and year from the archive filename when nothing else matches.
